description:
The SCOTT Spark DC 10 is built for riders who want more from every ride. Grounded in our world-class racing pedigree, it brings together short-travel efficiency and downcountry capability in a single, uncompromising package.

Every detail is tuned for a rider who demands speed, playfulness, and efficiency in equal measure. A low center of mass provides the control and stability to commit to root and rock gardens with confidence, while the lightweight HMF carbon frame delivers snappy acceleration and that responsive pop that rewards you on open tracks and flow trails alike. Designed around 140mm front and 138mm rear travel, the bike strikes a balance that reaches well beyond trail riding—with the performance to challenge benchmarks set by bikes in classes above it.

Freedom from suspension adjustment is built into the ride. RockShox's Pike trail fork and SIDLuxe XL shock—both with electronically controlled Ultimate Flight Attendant—monitor the terrain in real time and adapt automatically, keeping your hands on the grips and your focus on the trail ahead.

The build is race-ready and trail-hardened for you to ride without limits from the first time. A SRAM X0 Eagle AXS Transmission drivetrain, Syncros Silverton CF2 wheels, and internally routed cockpit deliver speed, precision, and reliability across every condition. Integrated frame storage keeps your Save The Day kit and trail essentials close, while accessible suspension settings and straightforward component swaps make it easy to tune the ride exactly to your preference—and get back on the trail without delay.
